submissions.decision-evidenced-short-settlement-reco:
WITH debits AS (
  SELECT transfer_code, note_id, CAST(substr(note_text, length('Debited USD cents ') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS fee
  FROM bank_note
  WHERE note_text GLOB 'Debited USD cents *'
)
SELECT t.transfer_code,
       max(0, t.instructed_cents - t.credited_cents - coalesce((SELECT sum(d.fee) FROM debits AS d WHERE d.transfer_code = t.transfer_code), 0)) AS unexplained_cents,
       (SELECT group_concat(note_id, ',') FROM (SELECT d.note_id FROM debits AS d WHERE d.transfer_code = t.transfer_code ORDER BY d.note_id COLLATE BINARY)) AS source_ids
FROM incoming_transfer AS t
WHERE t.credited_cents < t.instructed_cents
ORDER BY unexplained_cents DESC, t.transfer_code COLLATE BINARY

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT e.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY leaf_no, face_code ORDER BY event_no DESC) AS rn
  FROM face_event AS e
  WHERE event_no <= (SELECT cut_no FROM release_cut)
), pairs AS (
  SELECT leaf_no, max(CASE WHEN face_code = 'r' THEN file_name END) AS recto, max(CASE WHEN face_code = 'v' THEN file_name END) AS verso
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
  GROUP BY leaf_no
)
SELECT 'leaf_no,recto,verso' || char(10) || coalesce(group_concat(record, ''), '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT leaf_no || ',"' || replace(recto, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(verso, '"', '""') || '"' || char(10) AS record
  FROM pairs
  WHERE recto IS NOT NULL AND verso IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY leaf_no
)
